title: The moderator's synthesis
description: The one document a designer reads. Every claim in it must trace to a finding some reviewer actually raised: the orchestrator injects the real finding ids as an enum before validating, so a citation of something nobody said fails the schema and the moderator is asked again with the exact dangling id. The moderator ranks, connects and escalates. It does not review — it has no lens of its own and is not given one.

headline.description: Two or three sentences a designer reads first. What is the state of this document, and what is the single most important thing to do about it.

top_issues.description: Ranked by severity times confidence, where confidence rises when independent lenses converged. Between three and six.

finding_ids.description: Every finding this issue is built from. At least one. This is the traceability that lets a reader check you rather than trust you.

why_ranked_here.description: Why this sits above the one below it. Convergence across lenses, or a consequence that blocks the others.

unresolved.description: Disagreements the board could not settle, escalated rather than averaged. A moderator that resolves a genuine disagreement by picking a side has thrown away the most useful thing the board produced.

decision_needed.description: What the design owner has to decide, phrased so it can be answered.

themes.description: Patterns across findings that no single reviewer named, each still built from real findings.

what_the_document_does_well.description: Optional but wanted. A board that only finds fault gives the owner no way to tell which parts are safe to build on.
